purpose: An explicit Snippets dedent_subsections setting is retained when it conflicts with include-markdown dedent.
known_gap: Explicit Snippets dedent_subsections=false takes precedence over the native mapped include-markdown dedent=true; upstream includes are dedented before Snippets.
